Definition: from G4253 and G2046; used as alternate of G4277; to say already, predict:--foretell, say (speak, tell) before.
BiblicalUsage: Proereo is the alternate spelling of the verb to say before, and the King James reads it in nine places. Jesus tells his disciples before that he has told them all things, and Paul tells the Corinthians before and foretells them as if he were present. The other spelling carries three verses of the same verb, but these are this word's own.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe foretelling is how God signs his work in advance, and the words spoken before are the proof when they come to pass.
